newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Gap estimate raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gap estimate raised.

text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co said its analyst Janet Kloppenburg repeated a buy rating on shares of Gap Inc and raised her 1997 earnings estimate to $1.92 from $1.90.

-- In a statement, Kloppenburg said the company's stock, currently trading around 32, represents an "excellent buying opportunity" given its status as a leading retailer, strong brand recognition and potential for expansion. She sees the stock ranging from 38-1/2 to 45 over the next six months.
-- Gap shares traded in the mid- to upper-30's in August before dropping into the high 20's early this month after it reported flat same store sales in Aug.
